# The Editor Reads Your Template First

Version 1.1.2 fixes the visual editor for diagrams whose first line is written by a template.

## Fixes

- **A header after template lines is read as the diagram's own.** Content that opens with `{%- set … %}` lines and names its type below them, like `gantt`, renders fine on the card, but the editor showed a parse error on line 2, Flowchart as the type, and no nodes to bind. The editor put a flowchart header in front of the content before Home Assistant rendered it, while the card adds one only to the rendered text, and only when it has none. The editor now does the same: it shows no error, the type the rendered text declares, and its tasks or nodes to bind.

## If you already have Mermaid Card

Nothing changes on your cards; they already rendered correctly. Saving such a card from the visual editor may add a `diagram_type` line naming the type the editor now shows, which the card ignores while the content names its own.
